messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — we need to map the top customer onramp asks into concrete launch gates for the SmartServe pilot. I want a short dependency map and fallback playbook by EOD Friday.

Kevin (Eng): got it. can we list the hard blockers first? my reading: 1) runtime must support prefix KV caching for multi-tenant prompts; 2) infra needs predictable burst GPUs for spikes; 3) security wants an SSO/KMS attestation before any private deploys.

Samir (Runtime): KV cache is currently on the roadmap for M9 but we can do a focused M8 backport if we cut other perf items. tradeoff: higher latency on cold starts for 2 weeks.

Jess (Infra): burst GPUs are doable with the reserved -> burst pool flow, but we need the autoscale policy tweaked to 60s granularity and a quota increase request to cloud. need cost estimate.

Alex (Security): SSO + KMS attestation is non-negotiable for the regulated customer cohort. we can provide a scoped attestation template but timeline is 3 weeks for review + certs.

Maya (PM): thanks. customers also asked for model fallback when quota hits — can we define an automatic downgrade policy (lower-cost quantized model) + user-visible signal? that should be part of launch criteria.

Samir (Runtime): agree. runtime can implement policy to route to quantized-1.2 when latency > 600ms or quota used > 85%. needs a tiny API: `route_policy.fallback_model` + metrics hook.

Kevin (Eng): can the API be something simple? e.g.
```
route_policy: {
  trigger: "latency|quota",
  threshold: 600,
  fallback: "q-1.2"
}
```
We can have a canary that flips the policy per-customer.

Jess (Infra): infra checklist for launch:
- quota bump request to cloud (owner: Jess)
- 60s autoscale policy (owner: Jess)
- monitoring team alert for burst exhaustion (owner: Priya)

Priya (ProdOps): I can own alerts and runbook. will add a customer-facing status message pattern for fallback events.

Alex (Security): one more: must have keys in KMS + audit log export to SIEM before private deploy. I'll draft the attestation template and permissions matrix.

Maya (PM): good. can we capture the launch gates we all agree on? short list:
1) KV cache in staging OR documented cold-start mitigation + perf baseline < 450ms median (owner: Samir)
2) Autoscale + quota bump + cost estimate (owner: Jess)
3) SSO/KMS attestation + SIEM export (owner: Alex)
4) Fallback routing API + canary toggles (owner: Kevin)
5) Runbook + customer status UX for fallback (owner: Priya)

Kevin (Eng): i'll slot the fallback API in M8 sprint, need a 3-day buffer for QA.

Samir (Runtime): if we backport KV cache we push another perf optimization out of M8. but acceptable for pilot.

Maya (PM): prioritization note — customers A & B on the pilot indicate they'll only start integration after 1 & 3 are done. so those are critical path.

Priya (ProdOps): scheduling: can we have a cross-team check-in Tuesday 10am to confirm progress? I'll book a 30-min.

Jess (Infra): will raise quota request today, expect cloud approval in 48–72h. adding cost estimate to the calendar invite.

Alex (Security): target initial attestation template by Tuesday too.

Kevin (Eng): assigned: me -> fallback API, Samir -> KV caching, Jess -> quota/autoscale, Alex -> attestation, Priya -> runbook/alerts. I'll put PRs with draft config in `internal/launch-playbooks/ss-pilot` and tag reviewers.

deploy-bot: deploy check ok — no blocked pipelines for `feature/ss-fallback` but runtime branch `kv-cache-stub` failing unit tests (2 failures).

Samir (Runtime): thanks bot. i'll triage the two failing tests today.

Maya (PM): final — can everyone paste a 1-line status by EOD Friday in this thread. i'll consolidate into the launch gate doc and share with the customers. short and actionable only. :thumbsup:

Kevin (Eng): will do.

Jess (Infra): will do.

Alex (Security): will do.

Priya (ProdOps): will do.

Samir (Runtime): will do.
